sequenceDiagram
    participant A
    participant B
    A<<->>B: solid bidirectional
    A<<-->>B: dotted bidirectional
    B<<->>A: reverse solid
---
┌───┐     ┌───┐
│ A │     │ B │
└─┬─┘     └─┬─┘
  │         │
  │ solid bidirectional
  ├◄───────►│
  │         │
  │ dotted bidirectional
  ├◄┈┈┈┈┈┈┈►│
  │         │
  │ reverse solid
  │◄───────►┤
  │         │
